transaction’s Authorization Only request.

Number: 111 Name: Variable Information 
Indicator 
Character Type: AN Maximum Length: 3 bytes

Number: 121 Name: Partial Approval

credit/debit/fleet Partial Approval transactions.

transaction—and the corresponding network 
supports credit/debit/fleet Partial Approval 
transactions—the network can approve

character, and Card Discretionary Block Data is considered the 
data after the = character.  The = character is used instead of a

credit/debit/fleet Partial Approval transactions.

transaction—and the corresponding network 
supports credit/debit/fleet Partial Approval 
transactions—the network can approve

card between, but not including, the Start Sentinel and End 
Sentinel.  Account Number is considered the data before the = 
character, and Card Discretionary Block Data is considered the 
data after the = character.  The = character is used instead of a 
Field Separator.

Number: 121 Name: Partial Approval 
Indicator

 1 Supported 
This value indicates that the Merchant supports 
credit/debit/fleet Partial Approval transactions. 
If the Merchant transmits this value with a 
transaction—and the corresponding network 
supports credit/debit/fleet Partial Approval 
transactions—the network can approve

card between, but not including, the Start Sentinel and End 
Sentinel.  Account Number is considered the data before the = 
character, and Card Discretionary Block Data is considered the 
data after the = character.  The = character is used instead of a 
Field Separator.

 1 Supported

credit/debit/fleet Partial Approval transactions. 
If the Merchant transmits this value with a 
transaction—and the corresponding network 
supports credit/debit/fleet Partial Approval 
transactions—the network can approve

Sentinel.  Account Number is considered the data before the = 
character, and Card Discretionary Block Data is considered the 
data after the = character.  The = character is used instead of a 
Field Separator.

Number: 121 Name: Partial Approval 
Indicator

 1 Supported 
This value indicates that the Merchant supports 
credit/debit/fleet Partial Approval transactions. 
If the Merchant transmits this value with a 
transaction—and the corresponding network 
supports credit/debit/fleet Partial Approval 
transactions—the network can approve

character, and Card Discretionary Block Data is considered the 
data after the = character.  The = character is used instead of a 
Field Separator.

 1 Supported 
This value indicates that the Merchant supports 
credit/debit/fleet Partial Approval transactions. 
If the Merchant transmits this value with a 
transaction—and the corresponding network 
supports credit/debit/fleet Partial Approval 
transactions—the network can approve

character, and Card Discretionary Block Data is considered the 
data after the = character.  The = character is used instead of a 
Field Separator.
